scope: The exterior of the National Museum of Taiwan Literature in Tainan in June 2025. Includes the former prefectural hall, paired copper-domed towers, two masonry wings, mansards and the attached rear museum volumes. The outdoor sculpture, surrounding buildings and museum interiors are outside this architectural scope.

references.filename: Side view of the National Museum of Taiwan Literature.jpg

originalReview.notes: This side view shows a green copper dome over a circular tower, a pale rusticated ground storey, red brick and stone on the upper storey, repeated arched lower windows and the adjoining red hip roof.

quallaSearch.notes: Reviewed Qualla first and selected the exact first-party Lchung9779 CC0 exterior. The other local candidates show a book fair. The two archive object descriptions informed historical facts. Their digitizations were excluded because the approximate 1920–1945 date range did not settle public-domain status for this use.
